Subject: Unexpected latency + 5xx spike in us-west-2 — need immediate help

Hi Marissa,

We started seeing sustained latency (p95 jumps from ~120ms to ~900ms) and an increase in 5xx responses from Redwood endpoints serving our us-west-2 traffic around 12:45 PDT. Throughput hasn't dropped yet, but error rate has climbed to ~7% and several of our customer jobs are timing out. We attached a small sample of logs and a tcpdump.

Can your team confirm whether this is an AZ-level issue and whether a cross-region swap is possible? We have a heavy overnight batch at 02:00 PDT and need routing advice within the hour if possible.

Attachments: panthera-network-trace-20270630.zip; panthera-logs-5xx-sample.txt

Thanks,
Jordan Park

Marissa / Jordan — quick triage from runtime metrics:
- us-west-2 host error budget consumption spiked starting ~12:43 PDT; observed multi-region NACL flaps and a small number of GPU node restarts (likely due to kernel OOMs triggered by an anomalous workload pattern).
- Backend kernels appear CPU-queued; token processing latency increased and KV-cache miss ratio rose (suggesting prefix cache churn).
- No control plane outage — routing layer is healthy but several edge proxies are queuing.

Recommendation (fast mitigation):
1) Initiate cross-region steering of a slice (10%) of Panthera traffic to us-east-1 to reduce pressure while preserving in-region capacity. That can be done at the routing policy level immediately (no deployment).
2) If Panthera approves, increase the slice to 50% and enable prefix-caching bypass for long-running batches to reduce KV churn.

Risk notes: cross-region will add ~80–140ms p95 depending on request shape; for some real-time clients that may be unacceptable. We'll preserve sticky sessions for low-latency lanes.

I'll stand by for permission to enact the 10% steer.

—Rishi
Principal Infra Eng, Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Panthera Ops <ops@panthera.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 13:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected latency + 5xx spike in us-west-2 — need immediate help

Jordan — technical options and impact:
- Option A (recommended immediate): 10% cross-region steer to us-east-1 now, monitor error rate & latency for 15 min, then ramp if healthy. Expected p95 delta +110ms.
- Option B: Throttle long-running batch jobs in-region (we can apply a temporary rate cap) — low latency impact, but will stretch completion time.
- Option C: Full failover to us-east-1 — disruptive, will require temporary session affinity reset and ~200ms added p95.

If Panthera authorizes Option A, we can execute the policy change and provide a short incident runbook for your ops team. We also recommend a follow-up RCA with logs and kernel traces.

Attachments: (none)

—Michael Grant
